column1: # mapping_set_description: "Maps each concept in the document bridge ontology (bom.ttl) to the corresponding element or property in the CycloneDX 1.7 specification."

column8: comment
The BOM document corresponds to the root bom element in CycloneDX 1.7.
Generic component element in CycloneDX representing software, hardware, data, or AI models.
Software components are represented as Component elements with type application, framework, library, container, etc.
AI systems and models are represented using the machineLearningModel element on a Component.
Datasets are represented using data elements or Component with type data.
Infrastructure components are represented as services or platform components.
Security aspects are represented via top-level vulnerabilities, declarations, or formulations.
Metadata.authors specifies the author(s) of the CycloneDX document.
Metadata.timestamp records when the document was created.
Metadata.lifecycles specifies the product lifecycle phase in which the BOM was created.
Metadata.component defines the primary subject component described by the BOM.
Top-level dependencies graph describing relationships between components.
Version attribute on the root bom element.
specVersion attribute on the root bom element identifying the CycloneDX schema version (e.g. 1.7).
Metadata.tools lists tool(s); Tool.name carries the tool name.
Metadata.tools lists tool(s); Tool.version carries the tool version.
Digital signature structure on the root bom element or sub-elements.
serialNumber attribute on the root bom element serving as a unique URN for the document.
Component.name carries the human-readable name of the component.
Component.version carries the version string of the component.
Component.supplier specifies the organization or person that supplied the component.
Component.purl specifies the Package URL identifier for the component.
Component.cpe specifies the Common Platform Enumeration identifier.
Component.hashes contains cryptographic checksums (alg + content) for integrity.
Dependency relationships linking parent components to child components via ref identifiers.
Component.licenses contains declared or concluded SPDX license expressions or license objects.
Component.copyright carries the copyright notice string.
Timestamp associated with component creation or release.
Component.description provides text describing the component.
Component.externalReferences links to external resources (documentation, VCS, issues, etc.).
Filename for file-type components.
Component type set to application or binary executable context.
Component type set to archive or file container context.
CycloneDX key-value properties taxonomy describing component structure metadata.
MachineLearningModel.considerations.useCases specifies intended application domains.
MachineLearningModel.inputs and outputs specify data flow interfaces.
MachineLearningModel.datasets references datasets used for training or evaluation.
MachineLearningModel.inputs and outputs elements describe input/output formats and modalities.
Component.machineLearningModel contains comprehensive AI model metadata.
MachineLearningModel.trainingData describes training datasets and methodology.
Component or Data element type specifying data classification.
Data governance metadata covering dataset origin, collection, and ownership.
Data contents element describing dataset statistics and structural properties.
Data classification element detailing privacy and sensitivity level.
Infrastructure software specified as components with type framework, container, or operating-system.
Hardware accelerators or devices specified as components with type device.
Declarations section specifying compliance with security controls and frameworks.
Declarations.standards element documenting compliance with regulatory standards.
External references with type vulnerability-advisory or security-contact.
Vulnerabilities section containing CVE/GHSA identifiers and VEX ratings.
MachineLearningModel.performanceMetrics lists security evaluation metrics and benchmarks.
MachineLearningModel.performanceMetrics lists operational evaluation metrics and benchmarks.
External references with type vcs or distribution for source code location.
External references with type documentation for component manuals and docs.
External references with type model-card linking to AI model cards.
MachineLearningModel.modelParameters details hyperparameter and architecture specs.
External references with type documentation linking to dataset data cards.
